beats.caption: One click. Three companies.
beats.text: Three companies. One broken shipment. One click.

beats.caption: One read tool per partner. Nothing copied between portals.
beats.text: RelayRoom calls a single read tool on each partner's own website. The buyer's deadline, the supplier's lots, the carrier's routes.

beats.caption: 480 units · 12 hours early · +8% cost
beats.text: Four hundred and eighty units protected, twelve hours early, at eight percent added cost.

beats.caption: Write tools unlock only after a human approves.
beats.text: Write tools stay locked until a human approves. Then every commit lands inside the company that owns it.

beats.caption: Carrier fails → supplier step reversed automatically.
beats.text: And when the carrier tender fails, the completed supplier step is reversed automatically.

beats.caption: Independent websites cooperating without surrendering control.
beats.text: Three independent websites. One coordinated change. Nobody surrendered their data. That is WebMCP.
